The decisive mistake was the Orchestrator's ledger update at step 47. It judged that the team had "successfully navigated to the USPS Retail Postage Price Calculator" and directed WebSurfer to fill in Colombia on that page. The page's first field read "United States (Domestic and APO/FPO/DPO Mail)," so it was the domestic calculator, not the international rate tool. Every later step inherited this wrong target, and the USPS rate was never obtained.

AGENT: Orchestrator (thought)
STEP: 47
